acceptance_logic: K01 contact is a one-tick distal information spike.
K02 and K03 visibly change shoulder then torso while root address changes only minimally.
K04 carries the deepest pelvis/support consequence and heaviest dwell.
K05 is the first trustworthy rebase plant and first true root release.
K06 preserves upper-body lag after root release.
K07 overshoots rather than reversing prior keys.
K08 secondary lag settles after root/support stability.
K09 ends displaced from the wall/contact address.

differentiation.vs_timing011: Timing011 separates body/effect tail clocks; Timing025 remains one embodied causal chain with no detached effect clock.
differentiation.vs_timing013: Timing013 staggered readiness channels rebind; Timing025 propagates physical compression/load through body masses before root authority moves.
differentiation.vs_timing020: Timing020 localizes uncertainty dwell at a support gate; Timing025 has no uncertainty gate—the contact is known and its consequence travels downstream.
differentiation.vs_timing023: Timing023 fans one cause into ordered sibling consequences; Timing025 propagates one consequence serially through a single embodied chain.

direction.problem: A single impact consequence should not hit every body mass on the same display tick. The visible reaction propagates serially through the body chain, and the root is allowed to rebase only after support receives the consequence.

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Forward root travel is still free; body carries pre-impact approach energy.
Distal contact arrests the contact edge first; pelvis/root has not yet rebased.
Contact-side shoulder folds first while pelvis address remains nearly unchanged.
Compression propagates through ribcage/torso before support/root authority changes.
Pelvis finally absorbs the serial consequence; root drops and support widens rather than teleporting backward.
A new rearward plant earns root release from the blocked contact; this is the first true root rebase.
Root travels away after support earns it while upper body still carries wall-side compression lag.
Torso overshoots opposite the original contact after root braking begins; recovery is not reverse playback.
Arm/shoulder lag resolves after torso overshoot; support is already stable.
Stable ready state is displaced from the contact address; no return-to-old-clock or reverse interpolation.

pocket_rule: LET CONTACT CHANGE THE NEAREST MASS FIRST. REBASE THE ROOT ONLY WHEN THE WAVE REACHES SUPPORT.

queen_judgment.contempt: PASS - ten keys each carry a distinct causal stage; the impact wave, deep pelvis hold, rebound overshoot and delayed arm/torso settle avoid placeholder flipbook timing.
queen_judgment.differentiation: PASS - serial within-body consequence propagation is materially different from Timing023 sibling fanout, Timing020 gate-localized dwell, Timing013 readiness rebind, and Timing011 body/effect-tail separation.
queen_judgment.function: PASS - the timing insight is visible without metadata: contact changes the nearest visible chain first and root motion waits for support.
queen_judgment.taste: PASS - the body crumples in a deliberate traveling order, then snaps into an earned rebase instead of behaving like a uniformly squashed mannequin.

tango_rounds.correction: Fold the contact-side chain progressively while keeping wall contact fixed; defer pelvis/support collapse until K04.
tango_rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: K01-K03 read mostly as the same long arm line; distal-to-shoulder-to-torso propagation is too subtle.

tango_rounds.correction: Exaggerate delayed rightward upper-body lag at K06 and leftward torso overshoot at K07; settle asymmetrically at K08 while support remains stable.
tango_rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: K06-K08 recovery silhouettes are too similar; upper-body lag, overshoot and settle do not read strongly enough without labels.

visible_judgment.accel_decel: PASS - root velocity decays +1.00 -> +0.82 -> +0.56 -> +0.32 -> +0.08 before reversing only after the support rebase plant.
visible_judgment.authored_keys: PASS - decisive propagation stages are authored ASCII states; no endpoint interpolation, reverse playback, or hidden phase reset carries the performance.
visible_judgment.causal_timing: PASS - one impact travels distal -> shoulder -> torso -> pelvis -> support; the root does not truly rebase until K05.
visible_judgment.holds: PASS - the deepest pelvis consequence owns the heaviest non-ready dwell; transient contact and plant remain fast.
visible_judgment.overshoot_settle_lag: PASS - K06 preserves upper-body lag after root release, K07 overshoots opposite the contact, K08 resolves secondary lag.
visible_judgment.rhythm: PASS - 4t approach gives way to 1t contact and 1t shoulder spike, then 2t torso propagation and a 4t pelvis consequence hold before the 1t rebase plant.
visible_judgment.silhouette: PASS - distal extension, elbow/shoulder folding, torso fold, pelvis collapse, rebase, upper lag, opposite overshoot, secondary settle and displaced ready are distinct.
visible_judgment.support_contact: PASS - support stays bilateral through K04, K05 explicitly plants the rebase foot, and root release follows rather than preceding it.
